meaning: Our research priorities inspired by public evidence, not assertions of anyone's private plans. No priority number is a probability.

hypotheses.title: Residual-bank compression under explicit hardware and quality budgets
hypotheses.supporting_observation: An original fresh-process CPU probe now measures dense, full int8 dequantization and two-pass tiled int8 on prepacked synthetic banks. It records OS lifetime resident peaks, operator/load/packing times and numerical parity separately; this does not measure training quality, per-step packing, backward or GPU memory.
hypotheses.falsifier: Rare-information loss, training regression, or dequantization/backward/communication costs erase the practical benefit.
hypotheses.next_gate: Use real activation traces and matched token/time small-model training, including packing/retention/backward costs and measured GPU peak/throughput. Separately validate serial/CP outputs and gradients, state layout and scaling. Kernel allocation changes also require full-write, indexed-capacity, alias and packed-suffix correctness. CPU process peaks and restored unmerged PR claims do not clear these gates.

hypotheses.title: Versioned context and durable agent completion contracts
hypotheses.supporting_observation: Independent SQLite traces distinguish preserved rows, false-clean diagnostics and unresolved work. The merged pi adapter primitive additionally completes queued writes after abort, allows a subsequent transaction, and rejects expired handles in six deterministic Node SQLite traces. Direct host writes can be rolled back with the active transaction. Full pi storage and Cloudflare runtime were not executed. OpenClaw recovery/repair is now merged at 275c611e with the previously read PR head unchanged. Upstream CI job status is verified, but synthetic unit fixtures do not establish old-release upgrade or persistent task completion. Newly merged pi foreign-model-thinking filtering and OpenClaw exact same-thread restart recovery already implement concrete context compatibility/authority checks; source read, not executed here.
hypotheses.falsifier: A real harness already covers these contracts or does not exhibit the relevant failure; assumptions fail under concurrent writers, torn storage or external effects.
hypotheses.next_gate: Generate released Gateway-written state and execute real locked Doctor backup/exact-row compare-and-apply/reopen plus durable task progress. The inspected unchanged official upgrade fixture hard-requires core/codex2026.9.4; 10.3 needs an explicitly disclosed adaptation. Test model identity changes and exact known-rejection versus uncertain transport boundaries against the accepted implementations, rather than proposing their existing fixes again.

hypotheses.title: Adaptive evaluation bias in automated research
hypotheses.supporting_observation: Increasing public-feedback search budget inflates selected validation scores while sealed holdout fails to match.
hypotheses.falsifier: Independent holdout matches selected gains after budget and multiple-comparison controls.
hypotheses.next_gate: Fixed candidate budget, one-shot hidden evaluation, multiple seeds; do not rebrand existing sealed evaluation as our invention.

hypotheses.title: Reward and environment-version consistency in agentic RL
hypotheses.supporting_observation: A versioned failure ledger exposes reward inconsistencies hidden by retries or final-success-only reporting.
hypotheses.falsifier: Repeated deterministic scoring and perturbation tests find no consequential inconsistencies.
hypotheses.next_gate: Obtain exact task/model/harness/baseline configuration and per-rollout raw artifacts for PR2866 claims. Execute normal/inter-segment versus timeout/stopped and same-box/isolated scoring with real close-managed services in a supported runtime. Inspected Windows/POSIX/dependency blockers remain; fake close flags or callbacks do not establish service lifetime. Also reproduce the unmerged unified error-history timeout/ok contract.
